data.explanation: Fact A reports cumulative shipments as of 2021, while Fact B reports cumulative shipments as of 2024. The difference in the total number of shipments is explained by the three-year difference in the reporting periods.
data.reconciliation: The cumulative total of shipments naturally increases over time; the 2.8 billion figure in 2024 includes the 1 billion shipments delivered by 2021 plus the additional shipments delivered between 2021 and 2024.
